maddeler.e:
نرجحن (form IVq)
# نَرْجَحِنُّ (narjaḥinnu) /nar.d͡ʒa.ħin.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# نَرْجَحِنَّ (narjaḥinna) /nar.d͡ʒa.ħin.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# نَرْجَحِنِّ (narjaḥinni) /nar.d͡ʒa.ħin.ni/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
